title: Choose the visual world for the Ampline home page
question: The roll assigned The Generator Timetable. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Generator Timetable
options.lineage: the neighbourhood generator (moteur) hours sheet pinned in every Lebanese lobby
options.thesis: The device picker is the schedule: find your row, read the watts.
options.viewport: A posted notice: one-line headline, then a ruled device-by-category grid where every cell is the most watts that category delivers to that device, from the catalog. Tap your row and a ballpoint circle draws around it; the price-list sheet below re-sorts to what fits.
options.risk: The power-cut reference can read grim, or too local for a non-Lebanese client. The yellow sheet must stay clerical and calm, never hazard tape.

raised.raise: Napkin-line: the picked row's circle draws on and a line traces down to its matches, so cause and result stay connected.
Uncut sheet: the whole page is one continuous notice; no modal, every state lives in the URL hash and is recoverable.
Ledger honesty: spec-stated watts in solid toner, derived figures hairline, synthetic prices stamped as such.

options.label: The Spec Plate
options.lineage: the input/output label etched on the back of every charger
options.thesis: The store as the label you squint at, set at poster scale.
options.viewport: A giant plate: product name, then the OUTPUT table per port at poster scale; the device picker sits as the plate's compatibility line and rewrites the table.
options.risk: The most familiar landing for this category's honesty angle. Etched grey plates are where many runs land, and it can read cold and mono-label editorial.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.lineage: stacked glowing digits in glass tubes on a blackened steel panel
options.thesis: Watts as plasma digits: pick a device and the tube banks re-count.
options.viewport: Each product owns a tube bank showing its max port output; the device picker re-settles every bank with a cross-fade.
options.case: Fuses well: quantities become the interface and the watt figure is the largest thing on every card. Loses identification, a Beirut shopper has never met a nixie, and lands on the dark-plus-neon register.
options.risk: Reads retro-instrument novelty when the chassis takes over the page.

options.label: Endurance Livery Garage
options.lineage: Gulf and Martini stripe systems, number roundels, sponsor patchwork
options.thesis: Every product wears its wattage as the race number in a roundel.
options.viewport: Category stripes run as the spine; products sit as roundels with the watt figure as the number; the device picker lights the roundels that fit.
options.case: Fuses well: one heavy figure reads before any word and stripes make categories wayfinding. Identification is weaker than a Lebanon-native form and Gulf blue-and-orange is somebody else's identity.
options.risk: Costume risk: a borrowed livery reads as a tribute, not a store.

options.label: Signboard Canyon at Midnight
options.lineage: stacked floor-by-floor lit signs reflected in a wet street
options.thesis: Categories stack as lit floors of one building; stock is the sign's light.
options.viewport: A vertical spine of signs, ground floor loudest; in stock is lit, low stock dims, out of stock goes dark; the picker lights the floors that fit.
options.case: Fuses as the electronics street at night, which a Beirut shopper knows. Stock as illumination is clear, but the device-to-watts mechanism has no home in a signboard, and the dark ground is the category's opposite rut.
options.risk: Dark with neon is the predictable opposite of the category default.

options.label: Hand-Drawn Zine Explainer
options.lineage: marker lettering, doodle arrows and mascots on cream paper
options.thesis: The store explained the way a friend sketches it on a napkin.
options.viewport: A marker headline over a doodled device-to-charger diagram, arrows drawing on as you scroll.
options.case: A shopper replacing a dead charger is not here to be taught, and marker lettering undercuts price and cart.
options.kept: Draw-on connective motion from the pick to its result.
options.risk: Reads as a tutorial, not a shop.

options.label: Orizuru Crane Sequence
options.lineage: one uncut vermilion sheet folded through thirty-two steps
options.thesis: One sheet, every state still carrying every earlier crease.
options.viewport: A centred square diagram and a strict numbered margin column of steps.
options.case: Thirty-two folds is a lesson, not a storefront; nothing in the catalog is a sequence.
options.kept: One uncut sheet: no modal, every state recoverable.
options.risk: A craft metaphor with no commercial surface.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.lineage: one continuous red silk custody line across archival buff
options.thesis: Known passages in solid type, inferred ones in hairline.
options.viewport: A single ribbon-led column with dated small caps at every fold.
options.case: Museum custody is nobody's charging scene, and a timeline cannot carry a shelf.
options.kept: Known figures in solid type, inferred ones hairline, synthetic ones marked.
options.risk: Reads as an archive, not a shop.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What the eight reference stores ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A full-bleed hero with a Shop Now pill, a category icon row, then a best-sellers card carousel with strike-through prices.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design, and it needs the product photography the project does not have yet.
